params.caption: 🖥️ Biostar reveals the first Intel Panther Lake motherboard Biostar has announced a tiny board built around Intel's new Panther Lake chips, the first of its kind. Don't expect a pocket gaming PC though: the chip it uses has just four Xe3 graphics cores rather than the stronger integrated GPU. 🕒 Nov 16, 2026 · 19:08 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 👥 @intel 👍 Like if you want a Panther Lake mini PC · 💬 Would you build one? #Biostar #Intel #PantherLake #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
